links.outcome: Code extraction accuracy against reference labels across four model approaches
links.effect: Zero-shot LLM micro-F1 0.9614 with perfect recall for frequent codes; Bi-GRU micro-F1 0.9362, macro-F1 0.9377; LoRA outperformed QLoRA across all metrics.
links.quote: The zero-shot LLM achieved the highest micro-F1 score (0.9614) and perfect recall for frequent CDT codes, demonstrating strong baseline reasoning without task-specific training; however, performance declined for rare procedures and diagnostic code hallucinations were common.

unlisted_practices: Schema-constrained structured JSON output for LLM-based dental coding
Hybrid LLM plus supervised classifier approach for medical coding

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM prompting and fine-tuning strategies vs deep learning models for CDT code extraction on synthetic dental encounter notes; benchmarks model accuracy and hallucination rates without testing an organizational deployment safeguard.
